verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a meta-framework is a community comment naming SolidStart and its routing, though it criticizes that routing as very slow. That comment implies SolidStart exists and handles routing, but nothing establishes it as official or describes its data-fetching or full-stack features. The core library's SSR, streaming and Resources claims are framework features, not a meta-framework, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an official meta-framework (SolidStart), evidence of its routing and data-fetching APIs, full-stack/server function capabilities, and positive hands-on corroboration.
